source: IDSSE Figshare article 28196177 version 1, CC BY 4.0
reference: Raw ball BallStatus: 0 dead, 1 alive; everything else unknown and masked
features: Observed x/y only: ball motion, boundary distance, player distance, collective movement; centred windows 0.4, 2, 6 seconds; missing indicators
model: Standardised logistic regression, unpenalised intercept, L2 on coefficients, natural class prevalence; final refit on training and selection matches
selection_metric: Equal-scenario binary macro F1 on selection matches, tie prefer larger ridge then smaller switch penalty
scenarios: deterministic synthetic gaps, dropouts and jumps independent of labels
degradation: 43 percent ball missing in blocks of 1, 3, 8 seconds; 15 percent individual player observations dropped; 1 percent surviving ball observations offset by Gaussian 25m noise
validation: Freeze model before one held-out evaluation; report original and degraded separately; one-to-one maximum-cardinality transition matching within 2 seconds, timing for matched transitions and unmatched counts; no tuning on validation
integration: Separate binary live/dead sequence, frozen external control settings for H/A, D overrides team state. No challenge-based parameter changes.
